description: This Java class `ServiceMcaCondition` defines conditions for email message inspection within an email processing or filtering system. It includes logic to evaluate message headers, fields, or associated services to determine if certain criteria are met, supporting complex email filtering conditions.

classes.name: ServiceMcaCondition
classes.description: A class representing a condition for processing email messages, capable of evaluating conditions based on message headers, fields, or external services.

methods.name: ServiceMcaCondition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the condition based on an XML element and condition type.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the condition against a message wrapper, potentially invoking an external service or inspecting message headers/fields.

methods.name: getFieldValue
methods.description: Retrieves specific header or field values from a MimeMessage based on the provided field name.

methods.name: getBodyText
methods.description: Recursively extracts text content from message parts, handling multi-part messages.
